## Pricing policy
Published prices include Australian GST. The final scope, deliverables and acceptance checks are confirmed before work begins.

## Payments and intake
Card payments use Stripe Checkout in AUD. Direct USDC payments use native USDC on Base and require on-chain verification. Paid document intake unlocks only after verified payment.

## Examples
Representative demonstrations use synthetic or public data. Named case studies identify the customer.
